runs.intro: Each row is an attempt to run a Production. The newest one opens automatically.
runs.writingPlan: The plan is being written. Click to retry loading.
runs.empty: Run a song or video Production and its run will appear here. You do not need to type its ID.
runs.loadToInspect: Load a run to inspect its tasks and outputs
runs.loadFromList: Load a run from the list
runs.listHint: Attempts are on the left, newest to oldest. Click one to see its prompts, references, tasks and outputs.

rewrite.title: Thread instruction
rewrite.placeholder: Example: remove every MC, hoodie and chain. Keep only Tolkien dwarves.
rewrite.shorten: Shorten the visual body for MiniMax H3 (keep fields and refs)
rewrite.needInstruction: Write an instruction or tick shorten for MiniMax.
rewrite.proposalsReady: {{count}} proposals ready. Review and save the ones you want.

queue.title: Queue ({{count}})
queue.empty: This thread has no planned shots yet.
queue.driveOn: This shot receives the song vocal. Click to mute it.
queue.driveOff: This shot does not receive vocal. Click to mark sing/drive.
queue.repeatTitle: Repeat this shot and keep previous takes
queue.takesForSlot: Takes for this slot — choose which one stays in the cut

commands.pendingInvalid: The local recovery record could not be read. No command was sent.
commands.intentConflict: This request ID belongs to another pending command. Recover that command first.
commands.invalidReceipt: The result could not be verified. Recover request {{id}} before creating another.
commands.panelUnavailable: The collection editor did not confirm the requested view.
commands.contextChanged: The collection or editor changed during preparation. No new command was sent.
commands.unsavedChanges: The collection editor is busy or has unsaved changes. Finish those edits before asking the Wizard to change a collection.
commands.savedButNotVisible: The collection is saved, but its editor could not be opened. You can recover it by ID: {{id}}.
commands.revisionConflict: The collection changed from revision {{expected}} to {{current}}. Read it again before editing.
commands.pendingHint: Retrying keeps the original request ID. A saved collection will be recovered without creating another.

collections.empty: Create a Workspace to gather items without moving them.
collections.idsHint: Checks store exact IDs; changing a title does not break the collection.
collections.deleteConfirm: Delete Workspace “{{name}}”? No project or asset will be deleted.
collections.emptyType: There are no items of this type yet.

actionErrors.uploadsReadOnly: Uploads is a read-only virtual view, not a workspace that can be selected for generation.
actionErrors.switchUnconfirmed: The backend did not confirm the switch to workspace “{{name}}”; I will not claim it completed.
actionErrors.invalidName: That workspace name is not valid.
actionErrors.createUnconfirmed: The backend did not confirm creating and selecting “{{name}}”.

replies.switched: I switched to workspace “{{name}}”. Chat and the following actions continue in that context.
replies.created: I created and selected workspace “{{name}}”. Chat continues here and new generations will be saved in it.
